title: Can I introduce my boyfriend to my grandmother? Evaluating Large Language Models Capabilities on Iranian Social Norm Classification
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ability of LLMs to classify Iranian social norms, many of which are explicitly religious (e.g., related to mosques, hijab, and Ramadan) or moral/ethical in nature (e.g., the concept of 'taboo' and introducing an unmarried partner). It includes 'Religion' as a specific demographic feature for evaluating model performance.
